name: Joshua Allerton
source: The father of Takeshi Allerton. He specializes in new gaming technology. Joshua probably went into this field due to his love for games, puzzles, and so on. However, when he gets focused, he forgets to do things like change his clothes or eat proper meals. This worries his wife constantly.
